coverage.name: Kit Carson County
limitations: No participating-entities/IGA list and no TABOR notice posted on the county election pages as of 2026-09-26. The county's official sample ballot (signed by the Clerk and Recorder, marked 'Contains all ballot questions') was read in full: it has state measures (Amendments 81-87, Propositions NN, 132-137), judicial retention, and one local measure, Burlington School District RE-6J Ballot Issue 5D (mill levy override continuation for school HVAC/facilities; not housing). It has no county, city or town ballot questions.
Excluded: Burlington School District RE-6J Ballot Issue 5D (school mill levy override continuation; not housing). Sample ballot is image-only PDF; text read visually, not machine-extracted.
